name: Diotrephes
title: The Self-Exalting Leader
summary: Diotrephes was a man in one of the early congregations who loved to be first and refused to acknowledge the authority of the apostle John. He rejected the traveling brothers, spread malicious rumors about John, and excluded those who wanted to show hospitality from the congregation.

keyEvents.title: Refused to Acknowledge John
keyEvents.description: Diotrephes loved to have the first place in the congregation and refused to acknowledge the authority of the apostle John and his letter.

keyEvents.title: Spread Malicious Rumors
keyEvents.description: He slandered John and the other apostles with evil words, undermining their ministry.

keyEvents.title: Rejected the Traveling Brothers
keyEvents.description: Diotrephes refused to receive the Christian missionaries who traveled around preaching the gospel.

keyEvents.title: Excluded Hospitable Members
keyEvents.description: He prevented others in the church from showing hospitality to the traveling brothers and expelled those who did so from the church.
